span_deck.desc: a bridge deck of lashed boards: the tool you laid, as a walkable span

echo_marker.desc: the echo's ghost: a pale statue repeating your last move at the next gap, and the span it will lay

echo_statue.desc: the forgotten statue on its plinth: where the night ends

leaning_post.desc: a pier post that has leaned for a hundred years

oar_tool.desc: the ferryman's oar: the longest reach, one good span

plank_tool.desc: what is left of the oar: a plank, a shorter reach

peg_tool.desc: what is left of the plank: a mooring peg, the last use

objective.text: Your echo is crossing a beat behind you...
Hands empty? SWING (click) to whistle: an echo copies your _last move at the next gap.
Only the peg is left. Lay it at the _last gap.
Pick up the tool (E), carry it to the gap's edge and set it down. Climb. Never go down.

start.title: Crooked Ferry
start.text: One night a year the forgotten statue may move. The ink is rising and it erases whatever it touches. Lay your oar across the gap (E to pick up and put down), then swing to WHISTLE: an echo copies your last move at the next gap, a beat later. Every tool you use wears into a smaller one: oar, plank, peg. Reach the plinth at the top. Never go down.

victory.title: The statue stands at the top
victory.text: Dawn. The ink never reached it.

inked.title: Erased
inked.text: The ink took the stone and everything under it.

sim.name: mechanic: lay the oar, whistle, the echo lays it again at the next gap and the oar wears into a plank
win: oar, echo, plank, echo, peg, plinth
lose: stand still and the ink erases the pier

walk.name: with every span laid the pier climbs to the plinth

reach.why: summit unreachable before any span is laid
